Mohd. Javed Ansari And 2 Others .....Applicant(s) Versus State of U.P. and Another .....Opposite
Party(s) Counsel for Applicant(s) :
Mohd Khalid Ansari, Qaisar Kamal Ansari Counsel for Opposite Party(s) :
G.A. Hon'Ble Vikas Budhwar, J. 1.
Heard Sri Sri Qaisar Kamal Ansari, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Abhishek Tripathi, learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. In view of the order, which is being proposed to be passed today, notices are not being issued to O.P. No.2.
3.

This is an application u/s 528 of BNSS preferred by the applicants for quashing the Non Bailable Warrant dated 06.02.2025 as well as summoning order dated 19.10.2023 passed by Additional Civil Judge (J.D)/Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 6, Ghazipur in Complaint Case No. 14608 of 2023 (Reshma Parveen vs. Mohd. Javed Ansari and others) under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Shadiabad, District Ghazipur as well as entire proceeding thereof, on the basis of compromise dated 25.07.2025.

entities.text: Additional Civil Judge (J.D)/Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 6, Ghazipur
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Reshma Parveen vs. Mohd. Javed Ansari and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that during the pendency of the said proceedings, parties have entered into compromise out of the court, which is dated 25.07.2025,
Annexure-7 at page-50 of the paper-book, reference whereof has been made in paragraph-13 of the application.
Submission is that the direction be issued to the court below for verifying the same and till verification is done, protection be accorded.

5. Learned A.G.A. submits that as per the certified copy so annexed herewith, it appears that a compromise has been entered between the parties and thus, a direction be issued to the court below for verifying the same.

6. Considering the submissions so made across the Bar, the application stands disposed of requiring the applicants (parties) to appear before the court of Additional Civil Judge (J.D)/Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 6, Ghazipur along with the self-attested copy of the application under Section 528 of BNSS, certified copy of the order and original copy of the compromise by 17.10.2025, and on the said motion, the court below shall proceed to verify the compromise with most expedition.
